title: Wokenpok's Create Modpack
description: Create Mod with all the required addons to make sure it plays perfectly in Survival Mode!
body:
I would put images and other interesting things but I don't got that time.

Wokenpok's Create Modpack is just the Create Mod, but extremely enhanced using ad-ons for said mod. It also comes with a load of client sided mods that really enhance the experience but who cares (me).

Start the game by choosing your starter kit, these starter kits are currently experimental so don't be disappointed if they aren't the best, just contact me about it. Dynamic trees are here, with them being customized to have normal leaf collisions and more wood when you cut them. This mod also uses Farmer's Delight and Create: Food together to let you create your own cakes, sandwiches, cookies and a whole lot more!
For the technical ones out there, the pack also has Create: Encased to allow more mechanical blocks to be crafted with the oh-so-common copper instead of your scarce alloys of andesite.
